Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner committed a logical inversion during the final comparison. Despite correctly identifying the directors and their birth years (Victor Schertzinger: 1888; Giorgi Shengelaia: 1937), the Planner concluded that Shengelaia was older. This contradicts the numerical comparison (1888 < 1937), meaning Schertzinger—and thus Road to Singapore—has the older director.
